season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep. Peakbagger successful ascents: Jul 15, Aug 6, Sep 10, Jun 3, May 1, Oct 1 (all routes; no route-name split). Web: encyclopedic peak page gives July-September as the favourable window; guidebook-style pages for the neighbouring Deception put snow-free access from May-June with loose rock favouring early July. Keep Jul-Sep.

track.why: Sep 1 2025 summit, start 55 m / end 35 m from our Upper Dungeness Trailhead pin, high point 3 m from our summit pin. Report describes Surprise Basin, the Clark-Johnson col, a ramp trending climbers-left just below the col, a wrap-around line and a class 4 crack on the summit block with a class 3 bypass: all matches our Standard Route text (col, ramps, final class 4 push). Only Standard has a described line on this peak.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Same party, same day, same line as 2967710 (companion's log, 'Class 4'); one ascent goes to one route, keeping the report-bearing log.

facts.text: Past the upper Royal Basin tarn, cross a small ridge west into Surprise Basin; in early September the glacier there had melted back to a deep blue lake, and from its shore the notch between Clark and Johnson is in direct view.
Just below the notch a natural ramp leads climbers' left, and the line then wraps around the peak; in early September cairns marked it well.
Rock fall happens on its own in early September, and anything knocked loose sets off more; call out if others are below.
The summit block has a solid class 4 crack for the direct finish, plus a cairned class 3 bypass that is the gentler way to come down.
In mid-August 2026 the upper-basin tarn was boxed in by hard ice and low-fifth-class slab on one side and overhanging rotten rock on the other; scout before committing.

notes: Six of the seven Johnson routes are empty shells with no text, pins or grade (Deception Chimney, Northwest Face, Rumble Gully, South Terrace, Southwest Route, Staircase Route); all but Standard have no way to be matched to a track. The Staircase Route name looks like an approach from the other side (Staircase trailhead), and Deception Chimney sounds like a neighbouring-peak line, possibly misfiled. Both Sept 1 2025 logs are one party; used one.
